title: Create: Delete and Repeat
description: A mod that adds a Create style way to get rid of unwanted stuff
body:
![Create: Delete and Repeat logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8bed4c0eed9df972971247db94594ea8dc19591f.png)

**_Create: Delete and Repeat_** is an addon for _Create 6.0+_ that adds convenient ways to get rid of any item or liquid.

- **_Fluid Voider_**: a block that, when connected to a fluid tank and activated with a redstone signal, will start burning through the liquid in the tank, but be careful around it or _you might get burnt_

- **_Strainer_**: a block that, when placed _under a fluid tank and powered_, drains and filters the fluid from producing some items

- **_Industrial Cauldron_**: a cauldron that burns items fed into it if filled with lava and, just like the fluid voider, _be careful around it_

- **_Threshold Voider_**: a configurable block that only voids items when over a certain threshold. Has a filter that specifies what item is monitored and voided
  
- **_Fire Starter_**: Inspired by the Fire Starter weapon in the Game Ultrakill, this handy tool can spray gasoline and set everything on fire in seconds!!

![fire_starter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/650d011ee3c25f957167ac428152ac5ed3dfa9eb.png)
  
- **_Copper Cogwheel_** and **_Large Copper Cogwheel_**: a set of cogwheels made of copper
  
- **_Copper Plating_**: a copper block with connected textures
